fail_closed_result_class_policy: any ambiguity, missing operator GO, undefined source, or redaction violation maps to a fail-closed result class; the future check never falls open and never emits a value on error
future_presence_check_command_boundary: the future presence check must be a single-command, local-only, scoped operation emitting redacted boolean/class output only; it must make no platform API call unless a later explicit live-read-only gate permits it
future_presence_check_operator_go_policy: a future redacted presence check requires a separate explicit execution task and operator GO; this design gate grants no permission to execute
no_account_identifier_policy: no account id, user id, screen name, or handle is ever read, derived, or persisted by this gate or a future presence check
no_env_name_value_pair_policy: no environment variable NAME is ever paired with its VALUE in any output; a future presence check may reference an abstract source handle only, never a name-with-value pair
no_raw_error_policy: no raw error body from any source or endpoint is ever surfaced; errors are mapped to fail-closed result classes only
no_secret_fingerprint_policy: this gate never derives or displays any fingerprint of any real secret or token, and a future presence check must not either
no_secret_hashing_policy: this gate never hashes any real secret or token, and a future presence check must never hash credential material; no digest is computed or displayed
no_secret_prefix_suffix_policy: no prefix or suffix of any real secret or token is ever derived, displayed, or claimed (no starts-with / ends-with / first-n / last-n disclosure)
no_token_response_policy: no token endpoint response is ever requested, seen, parsed, or stored; token exchange remains blocked
